easy.title: Stegosaurus
easy.line: Genus of Late Jurassic armored dinosaur

easy.text: One species, Stegosaurus ungulatus, is one of the largest known of all the stegosaurians.

medium.title: Stegosaurus
medium.line: Genus of Late Jurassic armored dinosaur

medium.text: Stegosaurus is a genus of extinct herbivorous four-legged armored dinosaurs from the Late Jurassic.
Stegosaurus is one of the better-known dinosaurs and has been featured in film, on postal stamps, and in many other types of media.

deep.title: Stegosaurus
deep.line: Genus of Late Jurassic armored dinosaur

deep.text: Stegosaurus is a genus of extinct herbivorous four-legged armored dinosaurs from the Late Jurassic, characterized by the distinctive kite-shaped upright plates along their backs and spikes on their tails.
Stegosaurus is one of the better-known dinosaurs and has been featured in film, on postal stamps, and in many other types of media.
